objects.name: daemon_approval_pending
objects.sql:
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX daemon_approval_pending
            ON daemon_approval_requests(run_id) WHERE state = 'pending'

objects.name: daemon_checkpoints_run
objects.sql:
CREATE INDEX daemon_checkpoints_run
            ON daemon_run_checkpoints(run_id, sequence DESC)

objects.name: daemon_entities_live
objects.sql:
CREATE INDEX daemon_entities_live
            ON daemon_entities(entity_type, tombstone, updated_at DESC)

objects.name: daemon_input_pending
objects.sql:
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX daemon_input_pending
            ON daemon_input_requests(run_id) WHERE state = 'pending'

objects.name: daemon_runs_queue
objects.sql:
CREATE INDEX daemon_runs_queue
            ON daemon_runs(state, created_at)

objects.name: daemon_runs_thread
objects.sql:
CREATE INDEX daemon_runs_thread
            ON daemon_runs(thread_id, created_at)

objects.name: daemon_sync_conflicts_open
objects.sql:
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX daemon_sync_conflicts_open
            ON daemon_sync_conflicts(peer_id, entity_type, entity_id)
            WHERE resolved_at IS NULL

objects.name: daemon_approval_requests
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE daemon_approval_requests (
            id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
            run_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES daemon_runs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
            state TEXT NOT NULL,
            request_json TEXT NOT NULL,
            response_json TEXT,
            expires_at TEXT NOT NULL,
            created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
            resolved_at TEXT
        )

objects.name: daemon_entities
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE daemon_entities (
            entity_type TEXT NOT NULL,
            id TEXT NOT NULL,
            revision INTEGER NOT NULL,
            etag TEXT NOT NULL,
            payload_json TEXT NOT NULL,
            tombstone INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
            created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
            updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
            PRIMARY KEY (entity_type, id)
        )

objects.name: daemon_input_requests
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE daemon_input_requests (
            id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
            run_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES daemon_runs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
            state TEXT NOT NULL,
            request_json TEXT NOT NULL,
            response_json TEXT,
            expires_at TEXT NOT NULL,
            created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
            resolved_at TEXT
        )

objects.name: daemon_mcp_bindings
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE daemon_mcp_bindings (
            server_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
            encrypted_binding TEXT NOT NULL,
            updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
        )

objects.name: daemon_project_bindings
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE daemon_project_bindings (
            project_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
            workspace_path TEXT NOT NULL,
            updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
        )

objects.name: daemon_provider_bindings
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE daemon_provider_bindings (
            profile_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
            encrypted_binding TEXT NOT NULL,
            updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
        )

objects.name: daemon_run_checkpoints
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE daemon_run_checkpoints (
            id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
            run_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES daemon_runs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
            sequence INTEGER NOT NULL,
            safe_to_resume INTEGER NOT NULL,
            executor_state TEXT NOT NULL,
            created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
            UNIQUE (run_id, sequence)
        )

objects.name: daemon_run_events
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE daemon_run_events (
            run_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES daemon_runs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
            sequence INTEGER NOT NULL,
            event_json TEXT NOT NULL,
            PRIMARY KEY (run_id, sequence)
        )

objects.name: daemon_run_model_configs
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE daemon_run_model_configs (
            run_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES daemon_runs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
            encrypted_config TEXT NOT NULL,
            created_at TEXT NOT NULL
        )

objects.name: daemon_run_workspaces
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE daemon_run_workspaces (
            run_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES daemon_runs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
            workspace_path TEXT NOT NULL,
            created_at TEXT NOT NULL
        )

objects.name: daemon_runs
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE daemon_runs (
            id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
            thread_id TEXT NOT NULL,
            state TEXT NOT NULL,
            revision INTEGER NOT NULL,
            record_json TEXT NOT NULL,
            created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
            updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
            idempotency_key TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE
        )

objects.name: daemon_schedules
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE daemon_schedules (
            id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
            expression TEXT NOT NULL,
            timezone TEXT NOT NULL,
            enabled INTEGER NOT NULL,
            encrypted_template TEXT NOT NULL,
            next_run_at TEXT,
            last_triggered_at TEXT,
            last_error TEXT,
            created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
            updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
        )

objects.name: daemon_sync_changes
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE daemon_sync_changes (
            cursor INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
            entity_type TEXT NOT NULL,
            entity_id TEXT NOT NULL,
            revision INTEGER NOT NULL,
            operation TEXT NOT NULL,
            entity_json TEXT NOT NULL,
            created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
            UNIQUE (entity_type, entity_id, revision)
        )

objects.name: daemon_sync_conflicts
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE daemon_sync_conflicts (
            id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
            peer_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES daemon_sync_peers(peer_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
            entity_type TEXT NOT NULL,
            entity_id TEXT NOT NULL,
            local_entity_json TEXT,
            remote_entity_json TEXT NOT NULL,
            created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
            resolved_at TEXT,
            resolution TEXT CHECK (resolution IS NULL OR resolution IN ('use_remote', 'keep_local'))
        )

objects.name: daemon_sync_peers
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE daemon_sync_peers (
            peer_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
            local_cursor INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (local_cursor >= 0),
            remote_cursor INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (remote_cursor >= 0),
            updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
        )

objects.name: sqlite_sequence
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE sqlite_sequence(name,seq)
